subject: Post-demo intake: stakeholder roster + systems in-scope for security kickoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moretti <alex.moretti@clearline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo intake: stakeholder roster + systems in-scope for security kickoff

Alex — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your security review started without friction.

Key takeaways from the call
- Primary use: document summarization and routing for invoice processing (batch + streaming).
- Critical timelines: pilot in prod-ready config by end of Q1.
- Constraints: PHI-sanitized subsets, strict retention controls, and SSO + SCIM preferred.

Immediate asks / next steps (owner in parentheses)
1) Confirm econ buyer / exec sponsor (you). Who on the exec team should we keep looped on approvals? (Alex)
2) Stakeholder roster: security, engineering, procurement contacts we should expect on the kickoff. We want names + emails + preferred time windows. (Alex)
3) Systems in scope: a short list of environments & data flows (prod, staging, analytics ETL, S3 buckets, 3rd-party connectors). Please fill our inventory template attached. (Clearline)
4) Security questionnaire kickoff: propose a 45m session to walk questionnaire items, agree boundaries, and clarify evidence needs. (Jordan / Marissa)

Attachments: redwood_systems_inventory_template.xlsx — short template for the systems inventory.

Proposed dates for kickoff: Tue 2026-11-10 09:00-09:45 PT or Wed 2026-11-11 11:00-11:45 PT. Please tell us what works and who should join.

Thanks — want to keep momentum on this. If you prefer a different approach (we can run an initial async Q&A over the questionnaire first), say the word.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0162

From: Alex Moretti <alex.moretti@clearline.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 17:26:34 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo intake: stakeholder roster + systems in-scope for security kickoff

Jordan — great notes, thank you. Quick responses inline: 

Econ buyer / sponsor
- Laura Chen (CEO) 

Stakeholder roster (initial):
- Priya Desai — Head of Engineering — priya.desai@clearline.com
- Gina Park — InfoSec Manager — gina.park@clearline.com
- Mark Olson — Procurement Lead — mark.olson@clearline.com
- Laura Chen — CEO (informational on SLA/contract) — laura.chen@clearline.com

Systems in scope (high level):
- Prod cluster (k8s, services behind ALB) — handles PII-stripped invoices
- Staging (pre-prod) — mirrored subset of prod data
- Analytics pipeline (Kafka -> Spark) — transforms and stores derived features
- S3 buckets (ingest + archive) — location: s3://clearline-invoices
- Third-party connectors: DocuSign, Stripe (we can provide connector owners)

I attached a short export of our inventory (network_inventory_summary.pdf) to help — it's not exhaustive.

Kickoff timing: Tue 11/10 09:00 PT works for Priya and Gina. Mark will join procurement-specific follow-ups after the kickoff (procurement usually prefers an invite that lists contract milestones). Laura wants to be kept briefed but will not attend the kickoff unless something is blocking the procurement/contracting path.

We'll also want to understand evidence types early (SOC 2 artifacts, encryption at rest, retention windows). Happy to run the questionnaire live.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Moretti
Head of Platform, Clearline Finance
alex.moretti@clearline.com | +1 (617) 555-2410

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moretti <alex.moretti@clearline.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@clearline.com>, Gina Park <gina.park@clearline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mark Olson <mark.olson@clearline.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo intake: stakeholder roster + systems in-scope for security kickoff

Thanks Alex — appreciate the roster. I've booked Tue 10 Nov 09:00-09:45 PT for the kickoff (calendar invite sent). Agenda below and attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (short form) + our inventory template for any missing rows.

Kickoff agenda (45m)
- 0-5m: Introductions & goals (Jordan / Alex)
- 5-20m: Walkthrough of questionnaire items we commonly see that determine scope & evidence requirements (Marissa)
- 20-35m: Systems boundary discussion — confirm prod/staging/analytics/3P connectors in-scope (Priya / Gina)
- 35-45m: Action items & timeline: who will own each questionnaire section + procurement handoff milestones (Mark / Ben)

Pre-kickoff asks for Clearline
- Please populate as much of the attached inventory template as you can (environment, owner, data class, retention). Even a partial fill will speed the session.
- If there are specific hosting regions or vendor contracts that need mention (e.g., data residency), flag them in the doc.
- If you require any NDAs / custom contract language before sharing artifacts let us know — we can route to legal.

Links: HubSpot intake (HS-78934) and shared Drive folder are attached to the invite.

See you Tue — Jordan

Jordan / team — thanks, confirmed for Tue 11/10 09:00 PT. Attendees from our side: Priya, myself (Gina), and a systems engineer (TBD) who will own infrastructure answers. Mark will drop into the procurement portion as needed.

A couple of asks ahead of the session:
- We typically require temporary read-only access to a representative non-prod environment (72 hours) to validate logging and telemetry. Can Redwood provide a short-lived service account or a walk-through recording if access isn't possible?
- Please include a short section in the questionnaire for 3rd-party subprocessor agreements and their locations — we will need contract references for DocuSign and Stripe.

I'm attaching our access_matrix_template.csv to illustrate the level of detail procurement/security expects. If you can return the filled inventory + questionnaire by EOD Mon 11/9, that gives us time to route to procurement.

Thanks — Gina
Gina Park
InfoSec Manager, Clearline Finance
Gina.Park@clearline.com
